top_deficiency_types.title: Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Ensure heating and ventilation systems that have been properly installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.
Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Properly select, install, inspect, or maintain portable fire extinguishes.
Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
Keep all essential equipment working safely.
Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
Honor the resident's right to voice grievances without discrimination or reprisal and the facility must establish a grievance policy and make prompt efforts to resolve grievances.
